subject: How to face wrap boxplots of different columns?

messages.author: c166266d91ef9a29
messages.subject: How to face wrap boxplots of different columns?
parts:
Hi,

I have the following code of qplots:

qplot(release,discussion,data = derby, geom = "boxplot", main = "Derby")
qplot(release,raw_loc,data = derby, geom = "boxplot", main = "Derby")
qplot(release,ckjm_dit,data = derby, geom = "boxplot",  main = "Derby")
qplot(release,ckjm_ca,data = derby, geom = "boxplot",  main = "Derby")
qplot(release,ckjm_npm,data = derby, geom = "boxplot",  main = "Derby")
qplot(release,ckjm_cbo,data = derby, geom = "boxplot",  main = "Derby")
qplot(release,ckjm_noc,data = derby, geom = "boxplot",  main = "Derby")
qplot(release,ckjm_rfc,data = derby, geom = "boxplot", main = "Derby")
qplot(release,ckjm_lcom,data = derby, geom = "boxplot",  main = "Derby")
qplot(release,ckjm_wmc,data = derby, geom = "boxplot",  main = "Derby")


As you can see, derby is a dataframe which contains as columns 'release', 'raw_loc', 'ckjm_etc'.

Instead of plotting one below the other, I would like to properly use a facet that still put one below the other but in the same graph, by aligning the 'release' values. I am confused on how to code this because the boxplot is separating over release values, but the horizontal separation I now want use columns.

I tried working with the melt function but I couldn't manage it out.

Thank you!

messages.subject: Re: How to face wrap boxplots of different columns?
parts:
like this?

ggplot(df, aes(x=as.factor(X1),color=X1)) + geom_boxplot(aes(y=X2)) + geom_boxplot(aes(y=X3)) + labs(x="X1",y="value",title="Derby")

or this ?

grid.newpage()
pushViewport(viewport(layout=grid.layout(2,1)))
a <- qplot(X1,X2,data = df, geom = "boxplot", main = "Derby"
b <- qplot(X1,X3,data = df, geom = "boxplot", main = "Derby")
print(a,vp=viewport(layout.pos.row=1,layout.pos.col=1))
print(b,vp=viewport(layout.pos.row=2,layout.pos.col=1))

Honglong Wu
